name: It's a Plan v1 Issue Tracker with AI Agents (Community)
description: Self-hosted Linear alternative where AI agents work issues as teammates.

GATEWAY_CADDY_IMAGE.description: Caddy image this service's Docker build starts FROM (passed as a build argument). Pinned by tag and digest.

PORT.description: Port Caddy listens on (public domain target; Railway health-checks /_gateway/health here).

APP_URL.description: Public origin of It's a Plan; API and Web read it from here. After adding a custom domain to this service, set https://{your-domain} and deploy.

API_URL.description: Public URL of the api: a path on the same host, routed by this gateway. Keep it as APP_URL plus /api.

ITSAPLAN_API_UPSTREAM.description: API service on the private network (host:port) for /api/* and the OAuth discovery documents.

ITSAPLAN_WEB_UPSTREAM.description: Web service on the private network (host:port) for every other path.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds open requests get to finish when the gateway is redeployed.

PORT.description: Port the Next.js server listens on (Railway health-checks /login here; the Gateway proxies to it).

HOSTNAME.description: Bind address of the Next.js server (upstream default).

API_URL.description: Public api URL the browser calls, read at startup (set on Gateway).

SERVICE_URL_API.description: API on the private network; the web server streams avatars and attachments (/media) from it.

PRIVACY_URL.description: Optional. Privacy policy URL shown on the sign-in screens (Google sign-in needs one). Empty hides the notice.

TERMS_URL.description: Optional. Terms of service URL shown on the sign-in screens. Empty hides the notice.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds open requests get to finish when Web is redeployed.

API.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'i=1; until bun run packages/db/src/migrate.ts; do if [ "$i" -ge 20 ]; then echo "[railway] migrations failed 20 times, giving up (see the errors above)" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "[railway] migration attempt $i failed (Postgres still starting?), retrying in 10 s" >&2; i=$((i+1)); sleep 10; done; exec bun run apps/api/src/index.ts'

PORT.description: Port Railway health-checks (GET / answers status ok). Must equal API_PORT.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions and tokens; generated at deploy. Changing it signs everyone out.

APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts stored credentials (AI, mail, Telegram, Git) at rest; generated at deploy. Changing it makes them unreadable.

APP_URL.description: Public web origin (CORS, cookies, passkeys, email links). Set on Gateway.

API_URL.description: Public api URL (auth handler, OAuth issuer, MCP resource, email links). Set on Gateway.

CLIENT_IP_HEADER.description: Header with the client address for the sign-in rate limit; Railway's edge sets X-Real-IP and the Gateway passes it on.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: Railway Bucket S3 endpoint for attachments.

S3_BUCKET.description: Bucket name used by the S3 API.

S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: false = virtual-hosted URLs, as Railway Buckets use. Set true only for a bucket whose Credentials tab says path-style.

BACKUP_DIR.description: Where the database dump taken before each upgrade's migrations is written (this service's volume).

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days a pre-migration dump is kept; older ones are deleted at the next start.

SKIP_PRE_MIGRATION_BACKUP.description: Optional. 1 = apply migrations without the dump (only if you back up Postgres another way).

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional. Default From address for instance mail; the From field in god mode wins. Resend needs a verified sender.

SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Optional. Comma-separated private hostnames the api and worker may reach (e.g. a self-hosted Git server).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds running requests get to finish when the API is redeployed.

Worker.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'bun run packages/db/src/wait-for-migrations.ts || echo "[railway] could not check the database migrations, starting anyway" >&2; exec bun run apps/worker/src/index.ts'

APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Same key as the API (decrypts the stored mail and Telegram credentials).

S3_ENDPOINT.description: Same bucket as the API (imported attachments).

EMAIL_FROM.description: Same default From address as the API (notification email).

SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Same list as the API (webhook delivery).

TELEMETRY_DISABLED.description: Optional. Upstream sends one anonymous usage snapshot a day (TELEMETRY.md); 1 turns it off.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds in-flight deliveries get to finish on redeploy.

Telegram Bot.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'bun run packages/db/src/wait-for-migrations.ts || echo "[railway] could not check the database migrations, starting anyway" >&2; exec bun run apps/bot/src/index.ts'

APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Same key as the API (decrypts the bot token set in god mode).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds the bot gets to end its Telegram long poll on redeploy.

PGDATA.description: Data directory inside the volume (Railway base layout).

PGHOST.description: Private hostname of this database, used by the Data panel.

PGUSER.description: User for the Data panel and the other services.

PGPASSWORD.description: Password for the Data panel and the other services.

PGDATABASE.description: Database for the Data panel and the other services.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Superuser password, generated at deploy (letters only, safe in URLs). Changing it later needs ALTER USER too.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database created on first boot; It's a Plan keeps all its tables here.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private connection string used by API, Worker and Telegram Bot.

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Validity of the self-signed TLS certificate.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time Postgres gets to shut down cleanly on redeploy.
